messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: release v2.14.0 -> prod at 2026-03-22 23:00 UTC. Canary 10% for inference-runtime, rollout window 30m.

sandeep: Heads up — I'm pausing tonight's release. We have an ongoing incident in EU GPU cluster (latency spikes). Please hold any rollouts until oncall confirms.

li: +1 hold. Investigating increased memory growth in the batcher that looks correlated with traffic shape.

deploy-bot: Release hold applied to v2.14.0 by @sandeep. Canary canceled. Automated notifications sent to release channel.

maria: Can we pin prod to v2.13.9 in the release config so any automated retries don't pick up the new artifact?

katie: Noted — CS update queued. We'll post a public status blurb in 15m. :loudspeaker:

sam: ETA on root cause / patch?

li: Trying a config rollback of batcher max_batch_size in staging now. If that stabilizes memory we'll push a mitigation. ETA ~20–30m.

sandeep: Decision for now: no emergency rollback of prod (no user-facing errors), but hold the release and reschedule. New plan: reschedule to 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC with extended canary (25% for 45m) and SRE on-call monitoring. Pin release artifact and document rollback steps.

maria: I'll update the release notes and changelog now. Adding KNOWN_ISSUE: "batcher memory growth under certain seq-length distributions" and mitigation steps. Also adding a test prompt set for the canary.

katie: Change window shifted to 08:00 UTC LOW_TRAFFIC. Requesting SRE and infra on standby; enable extra traces for kv-cache and batcher.

li: If the staging config rollback looks good in 30m we'll try a limited patch deploy to canary later today; otherwise we move forward with the morning window.

sandeep: I'll open a follow-up ticket linking the incident doc and the new release plan. Please pin the previous prod artifact in release config:

```
  release_pin: "v2.13.9"
  rollback_command: "./deploy rollback --to v2.13.9 --services inference-runtime"
```

sandeep: Thanks everyone — holding for now. Will post another update once li confirms staging results.

katie: Adding note to the customer-facing status page draft: "Planned release postponed due to ongoing platform investigation. Monitoring and mitigation in progress."

maria: Done — release notes and internal rollout checklist updated.

li: Staging rollback looks stable at +10m. Memory growth mitigated by batch_size cap. Will run one more burn for 20m then report.

sandeep: Ok — if burn is clean we can consider a small canary today, but primary plan remains the 08:00 UTC rollout with extended checks.

deploy-bot: Thread updated: hold remains active. Next scheduled attempt: 2026-03-23 08:00:00 UTC.
